service.description: The capacity of people from fromDate to thruDate (days, inclusive; at most 400 days), each {partyId, source (available: their WetAvailable working hours; policy: the timesheet policy's), organizationPartyId, dayList [{day, isoDay, weekStart, base (the working hours before holidays and leave), holiday (its name or null), leave (hours), capacity}], weekList [{weekStart, base, holidayHours, leaveHours, capacity, workDays}], base, capacity}. With no partyId and no partyIdList, one entry with partyId null: the standard week of the user's (or organizationPartyId's) policy, as a placeholder is planned. policy with organizationPartyId (as get#WeekDays passes them) apply to every party with no working hours of their own. A person whose working hours or leave do not read is logged and planned by the policy.

The hours an allocation puts on each week of a capacity entry (get#PartyCapacity): hoursPerWeek spread over the week's working days in proportion to each day's working hours (base), or allocationPercent of each day's working hours, on the days from the allocation's fromDate to its thruDate. weekHours: {weekStart: hours}; total.

What the user may do with an allocation (workEffortAllocationId), or on a project (rootWorkEffortId): canView (sees the project), canRequest (a manager of the project, or an approver who sees it), canApprove (ADMIN or ALLOCATION_APPROVE, and sees it), canChange (an approver; the requester of one still requested), canCancel (as change, while requested or allocated). isApprover: the user approves allocations at all. A need (view, request, approve, change) not met is an error, except need none.

An allocation of a person (partyId) or a placeholder (no partyId: roleTypeId or skillTypeEnumId to staff) on a project or a work item of it (workEffortId), from fromDate to thruDate (days), at hoursPerWeek (above 0, at most 168) or allocationPercent (above 0, at most 100). By a manager of the project it is Requested, and the approvers get AllocationRequest; by an approver it is Allocated at once unless request is true. A person allocated is added to the project in roleTypeId when not on it (each on its own: a failure is logged).

The fields of an allocation, checked: a person, or a role or skill for a placeholder; days yyyy-MM-dd (or time stamps, taken as their days) with the last on or after the first and at most two years; hours a week above 0 and at most 168, or a percent above 0 and at most 100. Errors name what is wrong.

The allocation's person on its project in its role (Assignee when it has none) when they hold no current role there (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.add#WorkEffortParty); a failure is logged and the allocation stays.

Names the person of a placeholder (or another person for an allocation still requested): by an approver, who allocates it too unless approve is false; by the requester of one still requested, who leaves it requested for the approvers. The person is added to the project in the allocation's role when not on it.
Allocates a requested allocation (an approver); its requester and person get AllocationDecision, and its approval notices are marked decided.
Rejects a requested allocation with a reason (an approver); the requester and the person get AllocationDecision with the reason.
Cancels an allocation, requested or allocated (one who may change it); the history stays.

The notices of a change (requested: AllocationRequest to the users who hold ALLOCATION_APPROVE, not the requester; approved, rejected and cancelled: AllocationDecision to the requester and the person, not the one deciding), with whoText, projectName, hoursText, periodText, requesterName, actorName, decision and reasonSuffix; a decision marks the open approval notices of the allocation decided. A failure is logged and the change stays.

The allocations the user sees (those of the projects the user sees), for Allocations, ProjectTeam and PersonDetail. list: requested (to decide), unstaffed (placeholders requested or allocated), mine (of the user, or requested by the user), allocated, all (every status); the find: rootWorkEffortId, partyId, statusId, and fromDate with thruDate (days; those overlapping). Ordered by first day then project. A row: the allocation's fields with projectName, personName (null for a placeholder), roleText, skillText, statusLabel, fromDay, thruDay, hoursText, requestedByName, reviewedByName, isPlaceholder, canApprove, canChange (get#AllocationAccess's rules). counts: each list's count (withCounts).

The team planner (design-projects.md §9 TeamPlanner) from fromDate (a day; the start of its week, default this week) for weeks weeks (1 to 52, default 12): - weekList [{weekStart, weekEnd, isCurrent}]; - personList: the people the user plans, each {partyId, name, userId, roleTypeId and roleText (their most held internal project role), skillList [{skillTypeEnumId, label, rating}], source (of the capacity), weekList [{weekStart, base, capacity, holidayHours, leaveHours, allocated (allocated hours), requested (requested hours), assigned (the remaining hours of their open work items spread over the working days up to each one's due date; an overdue item's in the current week), logged (time entries), load (the larger of allocated and assigned against capacity, a ratio), over (load above 1), utilization (logged against capacity)}], allocationList (the allocations overlapping the range on projects the user sees, each with weekHours; one on a project the user does not see as hidden, Other projects), undatedHours (assigned work with no due date)}; by default the people with a current internal role (not a client's, a vendor's or a team's) on the open projects the user sees, and those allocated on them in the range; - placeholderList: the placeholders (no person) requested or allocated in the range, with weekHours by the standard week; - projectList [{workEffortId, workEffortName}] of the allocations shown; options {roleOptions, skillOptions, teamOptions, projectOptions} for the find; canPlan (an approver) and isApprover. The find: partyIdList, rootWorkEffortId (its members and those allocated on it), roleTypeId (holding the role on a project, or allocated in it), skillTypeEnumId (PartySkill), teamPartyId (current members, PartyRelationship PrtMember, of a team: an organization in the OrgTeam role). Each person is computed on their own: one that fails is logged and left out (failedPartyIds).

The people who could fill an allocation (workEffortAllocationId, or the fields of one not made yet: fromDate, thruDate, hoursPerWeek or allocationPercent, roleTypeId, skillTypeEnumId), ranked: those with the hours free in every week first, then by the skill (the higher rating first), then holding the role on a project, then the most free hours. The people are those who keep time (TimesheetServices.get#TimeKeepers), those with the skill, and those holding the role on any project. Each {partyId, name, hasSkill, skillRating, hasRole, fits, shortWeeks (the weeks without enough free hours), freeHours (free over the period), needHours, minFreeWeek, currentProjects (the names of the open projects, those the user sees, they are on), costRate and costCurrencyUomId (the person's current vendor rate, RateAmount RaprVendor, only withRates for ADMIN and holders of TIME_ENTRY_RATE)}. The allocation itself is not counted against its own person.
